about: Timeline path 3 of 3, 'Who is answering' (docs/research/2026-10-01-timeline-brainstorm.md): the book as the other side of a test, Jung 1949 to today. Opens on all three paths (series/explainers/timeline-paths.json) and flies down this one. Draft 2: Astra's rewrite (docs/research/2026-10-01-codex-timeline-paths.md), with page 7 and the caption moved from Six Lines to 8-Bit Oracle.
style: The header reads '8-BIT ORACLE // READY FOR INQUIRY' throughout (brand.header). Each query clears the screen like a filmbook page. The query is typed after '>' (dim green); the answer types out below it (bright green, 48 px); the part of the readout the answer is about is drawn beside it, alone. Chapter pages: a single word, centred, held 2 s. Own names only, never MU/TH/UR or INTERFACE 2037.

pages.q: AN OLD BOOK AND A NEW MACHINE
pages.a:
BINARY. CORRESPONDENCE.
WHO IS ANSWERING?
FOLLOW THE THIRD PATH.

JUNG ASKS THE I CHING
ABOUT HIS FOREWORD.
HE TREATS THE BOOK AS SPEAKING.

TURING PROPOSES A TEXT TEST.
WILHELM'S I CHING APPEARS
IN ENGLISH, VIA CARY BAYNES.

IN THE MAN IN THE HIGH CASTLE,
JULIANA ASKS WHY THE I CHING
WROTE THE NOVEL INSIDE IT.

DICK'S ANDROIDS LOOK HUMAN.
A TEST CHECKS THEIR RESPONSE
TO THE SUFFERING OF OTHERS.

A MACHINE READS THE I CHING.
OUR QUESTION NOW:
DOES IT READ THE BOOK WELL?

IT USES WANG BI'S COMMENTARY:
LINES TAKE MEANING FROM
THEIR PLACE IN A SITUATION.
